basic_info.description: Located in the desirable Richmond District, this property is a classic fixer on an extra wide 37.5 x 120 ft lot. This is a unique opportunity to transform a two-bedroom, one-bath house into your dream home. With its extra large 4,500 sq. ft lot, this property provides plenty of room for outdoor living, gardening, and possible expansion or development (subject to city approval). Prime location near Golden Gate Park, Lincoln Park, the Legion of Honor, China Beach, Golden Gate Bridge, and the Presidio, as well as local shops and restaurants along Clement and Geary Streets. A perfect spot to enjoy city living while being close to nature.  Whether you're looking for a project to make your own or an investment with upside, this property offers incredible possibilities. Bring your vision and your contractor and come have a look!
